hook.text: A burglar sits across from the family he robbed. He sees their fear. They see his story. Both walk out changed.

buildup.text: Restorative justice replaces punishment with dialogue. It addresses guilt through repair, not shame through exclusion.

discovery.text: The approach reduces reoffending by up to 27%. Offenders who feel guilt (not shame) are more likely to change.

twist.text: Punitive justice shames offenders into identity: 'criminal,' 'felon.' These labels become self-fulfilling prophecies.

climax.text: Restorative justice separates the act from the person. It says: 'You did harm. You can also repair it.'

punchline.text: Punishment assigns shame. Restoration assigns responsibility.

quiz.question: By how much can restorative justice reduce reoffending?
